meta.source: Ported from Reputation-Matrix2/liberated-toads-system.js into Waluipedia as a faction-linked system.
meta.note: Operational snapshot advanced after reading The Reclamation of the Vigilance. The ship is back in Toad hands, but not in the old order: the hardliner deck faction holds de facto control, Speaker L is absent or cast off per the anthem, Captain Fernback is trying to keep the Pond Patrol from becoming a private army, and the Council is writing motions after the deck has already started singing.
meta.rosterNote: Each cohort includes a full `roster` of named toads. The integer `members` field is still the headcount used by docket math (and barrel_survivors overlaps other cohorts). Many names use the '___ T' pun style (Pilo T, Geek T, Intel T, Capi T); others are toad-native. Roster rows are names/roles/levels — not full character articles unless linked elsewhere.

namingConvention.tPun: Say the name out loud with the letter T: Pilo T, Magne T, Budge T, Geek T, Nerd T, Intel T, Documen T, Equipmen T, Comba T, Warran T, Studen T, Recrui T…
namingConvention.toadNative: Pond/fungus/labour names without a forced T ending.

structure.established: Highsun 24, after the Reclamation of the Vigilance
structure.authority_basis: Emergency Resolution 17-A, Order 120 aftermath, and caretaker votes while Speaker L is absent
structure.description: After the Reclamation of the Vigilance, the ship is no longer a Legion trophy, but it is also not simply Speaker L's old sanctuary restored. A hardliner faction controls the decks and the anthem; Captain Fernback controls disciplined Pond Patrol personnel; the Cohort Council controls what legitimacy remains on paper. The chain of command is not broken cleanly. It is fraying in public.

speaker.philosophy: Order through unity. Safety through vigilance. Justice through accountability.
speaker.description: Speaker L remains the spiritual and legal center of the Liberated Toads, but the Reclamation record says he was "cast off" by the anthem and leaves his location unconfirmed. His old decrees still shape the docket; his living authority does not currently settle disputes. This is the central wound: the Pond Patrol was designed to enforce Speaker L's law, and now it must decide whether enforcing without him preserves that law or hollows it out.
quotes: This is not retribution's art, but the mending of the fractured heart.
By pond and law, by vow and steel, the wound must close for peace to heal.
We are not slaves to chaos. We are the Liberated.
Every toad who falls under my watch is a failure I carry forever.

activeVotes.title: POST-RECLAMATION AUTHORITY: DECK CONTROL OR CARETAKER LAW?
activeVotes.description: The Reclamation gave the Vigilance back to Toad hands, but the song and the decks are not neutral. The hardliner faction has momentum; Captain Fernback has trained bodies; the Council has paper; Speaker L is absent or cast off. The vote asks whether to recognize reality, restrain it, or pretend the old chain still exists.
activeVotes.background: Waluigi reads the Reclamation as victory and catastrophe at once. The ship is reclaimed, but the faction flying it may have decided liberation was only a phase.

options.text: Fernback Caretaker Law - Pond Patrol controls security, Council countersigns every political order
pros: Leaves paper trail for Speaker L if he returns
cons: May be too slow for a ship already in hardliner hands
Fernback becomes the face of power without being Speaker

options.text: Council Regency - no Speaker powers without 5/7 Council approval
cons: Scout seat remains vacant
Can be ignored by whoever controls the decks

options.text: Recognize Hardliner Deck Control - the Reclamation faction holds temporary ship authority
pros: Matches who actually controls the ship
Fast response if the Legion returns
cons: Rewards fury over law
May turn the Vigilance from home into weapon

options.text: Liberators' Circle Override - original liberators can veto any order until Speaker L returns
cons: Not elected by cohorts
May split ship command from faction command

activeVotes.speaker_statement: NO SPEAKER PRESENT. Deck control is a fact, not a constitution. Every order made before the Voice returns is provisional and reviewable.
activeVotes.notes: Current reality: hardliner deck control leads de facto. Current law: Fernback and the Council are trying to keep that fact from becoming permanent government. This motion is not a clean vote; it is a fight over whether facts on the deck become law on paper.

activeVotes.title: RAVENTREE MANOR: SECOND COHORT ADVANCE OR HOLD PERIMETER?
activeVotes.description: Raventree Manor remains active and hostile, but the Reclamation article makes one fact unavoidable: the reclaimed ship is absorbing every disciplined body the Toads have. The motion asks whether anger can afford a second cohort army when the first duty is keeping the Vigilance from becoming another prison.
activeVotes.background: Speaker Rivers has sent an observer memorandum from the old Diet network: do not feed another cohort into the manor while the ship, prisoners, and Speaker L chain of command remain unstable. Fernback agrees because he is counting doors, not speeches.

options.text: Second Cohort Advance - send Pond Patrol and Wardens back into the manor immediately
pros: Could recover evidence before the manor shifts
Shows the Patrol is not afraid
cons: Pond Patrol overextended
Manor already punished a siege
No Speaker authorization for lethal escalation
Strips the reclaimed ship of disciplined guards

options.text: Hold Perimeter and Observe - reinforce the cordon, no new interior advance without fresh intelligence
pros: Keeps pressure without feeding the manor
cons: Leaves trapped evidence or people inside
Hardliners call it cowardice

options.text: Proxy Reconnaissance - ask Disaster Inc. or a small specialist team to scout before any cohort moves
pros: Uses people already tangled in the manor
May reveal what a cohort army would trigger
cons: Relies on outsiders
Can become another Disaster Inc. incident

activeVotes.speaker_statement: NO SECOND ARMY WITHOUT A MAP. The ship is not stable, the Speaker is not here, and Raventree has already eaten one clean plan.
activeVotes.notes: Current leaning: hard no on another cohort army. Proxy reconnaissance remains possible; a mass advance is irresponsible while the Vigilance is unsettled.

activeVotes.title: WHAT IS THE RECLAIMED VIGILANCE NOW?
activeVotes.description: The Reclamation returned the airship to Toad hands, but the anthem and deck control suggest the ship is not simply a restored sanctuary. The Council must decide whether to resist the hardliner turn or legalize it after the fact.
activeVotes.background: The song is broadcasting. Waluigi calls the victory a catastrophe because the song sounds more like tightening chains than breaking them.

options.text: Sanctuary Ship - prioritize civilians, medical decks, and reunification of scattered toads
pros: Counters hardliner capture of the narrative
cons: Does not match current deck mood
May be too gentle to hold the ship

options.text: Fortress Ship - arm the Vigilance and prepare for another Legion boarding
cons: Turns home into barracks
May legalize hardliner command

options.text: Mobile Court - bring the Accountability Docket aboard and hear every charge in public
cons: Slow
Dangerous if enemies exploit public hearings

options.text: Broadcast Platform - use the ship and anthem to recruit scattered toads
pros: Uses the victory while morale is hot
cons: Propaganda can outrun truth
Waluigi already hates the song
Can make chains sound like unity

activeVotes.speaker_statement: The ship is home, fortress, court, and mouthpiece at once. Pick one too quickly and the others will pick for you.
activeVotes.notes: Fortress/broadcast blocs are stronger than the sanctuary bloc. This reflects the Reclamation article: the ship is back, but not gentle. The question is whether law can catch up before the anthem becomes policy.

activeVotes.title: SPEAKER RIVERS OBSERVER COMPACT
activeVotes.description: Speaker Rivers resigned from the Midlands Diet over the Iron Mandate and is observing the Pond Patrol crisis through old Diet channels. His question is not how to command the Toads; it is how to keep their emergency votes from becoming the same kind of pre-counted parliament he walked out of.
activeVotes.background: Rivers is not a Toad commander and cannot vote in the Cohort Council. His value is procedural memory: he knows what a captured parliament looks like because he resigned from one.

options.text: Admit Rivers as non-voting observer and file his memoranda with Council records
cons: Outsider influence during leadership vacuum
May expose Pond Patrol deliberations

options.text: Receive memoranda only; no observer standing
cons: Looks paranoid
Weakens political bridge to anti-Mandate seats
Throws away the one Diet figure who acted on conscience

activeVotes.speaker_statement: Rivers does not command us. That is why he may be useful.
activeVotes.notes: Rivers' practical position on Raventree: observe and contain, do not order another cohort advance while the Patrol is stretched thin and the reclaimed ship is politically unstable.

recentVotes.title: Crisis Response: Order 120
recentVotes.result: Improvised survival response; no suicide assault enacted before the wider Aegis/Reclamation chain changed the board
recentVotes.summary: Captain Fernback assumed temporary command after the Speaker L decoy was exposed and Order 120 threatened to execute Toad prisoners. The vote did not produce a clean doctrine; it produced the caretaker crisis that still governs the Pond Patrol.
recentVotes.long_term_effects: Established Fernback as temporary security authority but left the Speaker L legitimacy question unresolved.

recentVotes.title: The Scavenging Doctrine
recentVotes.result: Option B (Dan's Proposal) - Large cautious expeditions
recentVotes.summary: Established protocol for larger, more cautious resource gathering expeditions over Archie's proposed small high-risk teams. This marked a significant return to influence for Dan and a shift toward safety.
recentVotes.long_term_effects: Resource gathering slowed but casualties reduced

recentVotes.title: Emergency Resolution 17-A
recentVotes.result: Enacted - Speaker L granted emergency powers
recentVotes.summary: Granted Speaker L emergency powers following the Raventree Manor crisis. Established the Accountability Docket. Created the current governance structure.
recentVotes.long_term_effects: Centralized authority, increased order, some liberty concerns

recentVotes.title: Containment of Raventree Manor
recentVotes.summary: Authorized the Pond Patrol to establish a containment perimeter around Raventree Manor to prevent supernatural threats from spreading.
recentVotes.dissent: Healer Mistpetal voted against, concerned about cutting off trapped individuals

recentVotes.title: Medical Priority Protocol
recentVotes.summary: Established formal triage protocols for the overwhelmed Menders cohort. Core party members do not receive priority over other toads.
recentVotes.long_term_effects: Fair but slower treatment for high-profile patients

events.title: Vigilance Reclaimed, Chain of Command Unsettled
events.description: The Liberated Toads hold the Vigilance again, but the Reclamation anthem and hardliner deck faction make the victory politically unstable. Captain Fernback opens a caretaker authority vote after realizing disciplined patrols do not automatically mean legitimate command.

events.title: Raventree Second Advance Motion
events.description: Warden Thornshell proposes another cohort advance into Raventree Manor. Speaker Rivers, observing through old Diet channels, advises containment and no second army until the ship and chain of command stabilize.

events.title: Vigilance Identity Debate
events.description: Council opens the question of whether the reclaimed Vigilance is sanctuary, fortress, court, or broadcast platform. Fortress and broadcast blocs are stronger than the sanctuary bloc; Waluigi hears the anthem as chains tightening.

events.title: Speaker Rivers Observer Compact
events.description: Scribe Dewdrop proposes accepting Speaker Rivers as a non-voting observer. The issue is not command; it is whether an anti-Mandate parliamentarian can keep the Toads from becoming a parliament that counts votes after the outcome is decided.

events.title: Iron Mandate Enacted
events.description: The Midlands Diet passes the Iron Mandate. The Liberated Toads are classified as an 'organized supernatural entity.'

events.title: Dragon Conspiracy Revealed
events.description: Robinson (Markop's father) discovers the Dragon-Empire war is a fabrication. He and the dragon 'Ignis-Major' are captured by the Legion.

events.title: Massacre at Aegis Command
events.description: Infiltration failed. Bones stabbed by General Ironhand. A 'Green Decoy' of Speaker L was discovered. Ironhand issues 'Order 120': Execute all Toad prisoners.

events.title: Banishment of the Wraith
events.description: The party defeats an Arcane Wraith at Raventree Manor. Dan fights one-armed; Bowser physically assaults the ghost. The Oracle banishes the entity.

events.title: Iron Mandate Enacted
events.description: The Midlands Diet passes the Iron Mandate 28-8-3, granting the Iron Legion emergency powers to purge supernatural threats. The Liberated Toads are now classified as an 'organized supernatural entity.'

events.title: Emergency Vote Called
events.description: Speaker L convenes the Council to vote on the faction's response. Four options presented: evacuation, diplomacy, resistance, or strategic withdrawal.

events.title: Council Deliberation
events.description: The Council debates. Strategic Withdrawal currently leads with 3 votes. Legion patrols are mobilizing.

events.title: Vigilance Captured
events.description: The Iron Legion boards and captures the Vigilance.

events.title: Bones Confirmed Captured
events.description: Bones is confirmed held at an Imperial Processing Facility. Council begins planning rescue operation.

events.title: Ryan Meets Rakasha
events.description: Ryan survives their fall and is taken in by a Rakasha spirit-walker who senses their magical potential.

events.title: Spider Grove Rescue
events.description: Markop and Remi rescue Eager from a web-choked grove in Raventree Manor, defeating a massive Arachnid Matriarch.

events.title: Containment Perimeter
events.description: Pond Patrol establishes containment perimeter around Raventree Manor. The manor responds by manifesting powerful wraiths.

events.title: Green T Lost
events.description: Green T is violently pulled into a mirror dimension by a supernatural entity. Status: Unknown, presumed lost.

events.title: Archie Surrenders
events.description: Archie surrenders to Speaker L to buy time, but a glass monster emerges from a mirror, complicating the situation.

events.title: Emergency Powers Granted
events.description: Council unanimously passes Emergency Resolution 17-A, granting Speaker L emergency powers. The Accountability Docket is established.

events.title: Supernatural Sovereignty Act
events.description: The Regal Empire passes a law declaring organized vampires and werewolves illegal, effectively declaring war on supernatural factions.

events.title: Raventree Standoff
events.description: Speaker L's Pond Patrol besieges Archie and hjumpik in the manor after a failed healing attempt on Eager.

events.title: Scavenging Doctrine Vote
events.description: Dan's proposal for cautious expeditions defeats Archie's high-risk plan 5-1. First major policy shift toward safety.

events.title: The Dinner That Broke Time
events.description: Toads enter Shadeward Mansion seeking Archie. Encounter the Oracle, time loops, multiple Archie clones, and an Iron Legion raid.

events.title: The Mole Revealed
events.description: The Mole's true allegiance to the Iron Legion is exposed. Bones is captured during the chaos. Trust in the Scout cohort shattered.

events.title: FNG Remi Arrives
events.description: Remi is discovered in a crate. Wario gives her an exploding box. She survives and is offered a place in his crew.

events.title: Cone of Cold Incident
events.description: Waluigi's Cone of Cold spell freezes Eager solid and injures Remi. Eager presumed dead by the crew.

events.title: 150 Toads Discovered
events.description: The Iron Legion reveals that 150+ trafficked toads are hidden in barrels throughout the ship, accessible via Mini-Mushroom.

events.title: X.O. Neutralized
events.description: The party, with critical assistance from Dan the Toad, neutralizes X.O. and regains control of the Vigilance.

coreToads.name: Dan

complicated: Waluigi - nearly killed by his Cone of Cold

coreToads.name: Ryan

personality.bond: My spellbook is my most treasured possession
My weapons are extensions of myself

coreToads.name: Bones
coreToads.title: The Unbreakable
coreToads.status: Active - Cleaned up from being grotesque mushroom
coreToads.background: Awaiting execution at Aegis Command. Bones was recognized by Byscilla Danos and dragged away.

personality.bond: I will break anyone who hurts my friends
personality.flaw: Sometimes can't stop once I start

coreToads.name: Toad Lee
coreToads.title: The Relentless
coreToads.background: Toad Lee has once again survived the impossible. Finding refuge in a Hag's house, he found Waluigi caged and injured. Showing quick thinking, he tricked the Hag (Stucky) into revealing how to disarm her own bear trap, then broke Waluigi out. He is currently fleeing through a sprite-infested greenhouse. Toad Lee managed to sneak past the satyrs and attempted to take some spoils from the fallen goblin. Toad Lee broke through a wall with Hjumpik and grabbed some gold. Kidnapped. None mentioned.

personality.bond: The Barrel Survivors are my family now

coreToads.name: Waluigi
coreToads.title: The Lanky Sorcerer
coreToads.background: A chaotic variable in the equation. Waluigi previously froze Eager, but found himself captured by Stucky the Hag in the Planar Fracture. His leg was brutally injured (bone exposed). Toad Lee saved him from being eaten. Waluigi was injured while triggering an explosion.

personality.ideal: Everyone cheats, I just do it better

coreToads.affiliationLabel: Not a Liberated Toad — outside party, docket subject
coreToads.affiliationNote: Waluigi is NOT a member of the Liberated Toads and NOT part of the Pond Patrol. He appears in this record only because he is a subject of the Accountability Docket and was present for the Raventree events. His abilities belong to his own sheet, not the Toad roster.

coreToads.name: The Mole
coreToads.title: The Traitor

personality.bond: Iron Legion is my true family

coreToads.affiliationNote: Former Scout cohort leader. Betrayed the Cohort on Day 16; the seventh Council seat is still empty because of him.

pondPatrolNote: The Pond Patrol is a 24-member overextended cohort commanded by Captain Fernback while Speaker L remains absent or cast off. It guards the reclaimed Vigilance, maintains the Raventree perimeter, handles prisoners and evidence, and cannot responsibly send another cohort army into the manor without stripping the ship or pretending hardliner deck control is the same thing as lawful command.
